final: WITH groups AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS group_sum FROM income GROUP BY link_to_member), shares AS (SELECT group_sum * 1.0 / SUM(group_sum) OVER () AS share FROM groups), averages AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(group_sum) AS total_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess_share FROM groups JOIN shares USING (link_to_member, group_sum) CROSS JOIN averages WHERE share > avg_share
